title: Noise operator Fourier sum at the all-one point
statement: For every nonnegative integer $m$ and real $\rho$, let $f$ be the indicator of the middle layer of $\{−1,1\}^{2m}$, consisting of points with exactly $m$ positive coordinates. The noise operator applied to $f$, evaluated at the all-one point, equals $\displaystyle\sum_{U\subseteq[2m]}\widehat f(U)\rho^{|U|}$, where $\widehat f(U)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $U$.
